question: Do you really make your ice cream yourselves?
answer: Yes, for us, true craftsmanship is key, and we freshly produce every single flavor in our own manufactory with great love. We consistently avoid industrial ready-mixes and instead rely on passion and traditional churning methods. This way, we guarantee you the authentic Nicezeit taste that you can clearly savor in every scoop. This is our daily promise to you for the highest quality and freshness.

question: Do you also have vegan ice cream?
answer: Of course, every ice cream lover gets their money's worth with us, whether you eat vegan or just want to try something new. Our fruity sorbets are naturally purely plant-based, and we are constantly tinkering with new, creamy alternatives based on oat or nut drinks. We believe that no one should have to miss out on perfect enjoyment just because they don't consume animal products. Just ask our team on site about the current changing vegan highlights in our display case.

question: What ingredients go into your ice cream?
answer: Only selected raw materials make it into our ice cream, which we choose for you with the greatest care and according to strict quality criteria. We use fresh milk from the region, real Bourbon vanilla, and fully ripe fruits whenever the season allows. We deliberately completely avoid artificial flavors, colorings, or unnecessary preservatives. We believe that good ingredients speak for themselves and do not need any chemical frills.

question: Can Nicezeit be booked for events?
answer: Absolutely, we are very happy to bring Nicezeit directly to your wedding, your company event, or your private garden party. With our charming mobile ice cream truck, we ensure beaming eyes among your guests and serve your favorite flavors directly on site. Simply send us a short message via our contact form with the key data for your planned celebration. We will then create an individual offer for you so that your event becomes an ice-cold success.

question: Why are you closed in winter?
answer: We also need a little break to start the next season with full energy and new creative ice cream creations. Since we consistently rely on fresh and seasonal ingredients, production in deep winter simply does not match our high quality standards. Instead, we use the cold months intensively to refine our recipes and spruce up our shop for the coming spring. The anticipation of the first scoop in March is the most beautiful joy anyway, isn't it?
